name: Xero
description: Xero is cloud accounting software with a developer platform offering OAuth 2.0 APIs, SDKs and an MCP server.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 authorization code (with PKCE) and client credentials via Custom Connections.
gate_detail: Free developer account and Starter app plan at no charge, limited to 5 connections. Core and higher plans require app certification and a credit card.
api_scope: Accounting and related APIs with SDKs; advanced plan adds Journals endpoint, Practice Manager API and Bulk Connections.
mcp_notes: Xero's AI Toolkit includes an MCP Server, with a Remote MCP FAQ on developer.xero.com; no URL given.
blocker_detail: Beyond 5 connections, paid tiers requiring app certification apply, billed monthly by credit card.

evidence.quote: Xero secures its APIs with http and oauth2 across 3 declared security schemes, as derived from its OpenAPI definitions.
Sign up for a free account to build on the Xero platform.
Monthly Tier Fee No charge $35 AUD $245 AUD $1445 AUD Price on Application
Your card details will be required when moving from the Starter to the Core plan.
Get Started with Xero's AI Toolkit including OpenAI Agents SDK, MCP Server, LangChain and prompt examples.

issues: Webhooks and sandbox are not covered by the sources.
